title: Update YES agreement message text and bullet list

requirements.summary: Replace the YES-click agreement message headline and bullets on the Valentine invitation screen to match the exact provided text with no extra trailing sentence.
acceptanceCriteria: After clicking the "YES" button, the agreement message becomes visible immediately.
The agreement message headline text is exactly: "By clicking YES you agree to:"
The agreement message shows exactly four bullet items, in the exact order and wording specified: Unlimited cuddles; Lifetime supply of milk; Unlimited sex; Daily minimum 1 nudes.
The agreement message contains no additional sentence such as "Effective immediately! 🚀" (or any other extra line) beyond the headline and four bullets.
All other YES-click behaviors remain unchanged (buttons hide after 1 second; confetti runs for 5 seconds).

file_operations.description: Update the conditional agreement message rendered when `showAgreement` is true: keep the headline text exactly "By clicking YES you agree to:", replace the existing bullet items with exactly four bullets in the specified order (Unlimited cuddles; Lifetime supply of milk; Unlimited sex; Daily minimum 1 nudes), and remove the trailing sentence paragraph (e.g., "Effective immediately! 🚀") so only the headline and four bullets remain. Preserve existing YES-click timing/side effects (immediate reveal, hide buttons after 1s, confetti for 5s).
